# run
# note the block is ended on the way to the wire and not in the file, which run
# note does not rewrite: rr fmt is what ends it there
>>> f.rr
-- sends an exchange that ends after the last header --
GET {{url}}/ HTTP/1.1
Host: example.com
>>> want f.rr
-- sends an exchange that ends after the last header --
GET {{url}}/ HTTP/1.1
Host: example.com
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Length: 5
Content-Type: text/plain

hello
